blocking_issues.detail: COUNTRY-CONTEXT.md §14 requires at least 1,600 substantive words and 12 H2 analytical sections in each locale for dossiers dated on or after 2026-09-23. Mechanical QA found approximately 1,348 substantive words and 9 H2 sections in EN, and approximately 1,425 substantive words and 9 H2 sections in PT-BR.

The analysis is coherent but compresses fiscal/federal implementation, housing and land-use constraints, grid governance, labor and migration, and external dollar/trade transmission. Expansion must add distinct sourced mechanisms rather than repeat the thesis.

required_fixes: Raise each locale above 1,600 substantive words and at least 12 H2 analytical sections with distinct mechanisms, not filler.
Preserve EN/PT-BR semantic parity and reverify every new material claim externally.
Preserve the current evidence-bearing visual floor and explicit links to the two canonical triggering reports.
evidence: BEA confirms Q2 2026 real GDP growth at 1.5% annualized versus 2.1% in Q1.
BLS confirms August 2026 unemployment at 4.1% and labor-force participation at 61.6%.
Federal Reserve G.17 confirms August industrial production unchanged, manufacturing -0.3%, total IP +1.4% year over year and capacity utilization 76.3%.
BEA/Census confirms July 2026 exports $310.7bn, imports $399.3bn, total deficit $88.6bn, goods deficit $119.6bn and services surplus $31.0bn.
Census confirms net international migration fell from 2.7m to 1.3m and natural increase was about 519k.
Mechanical repository count: EN ≈1,348 substantive words / 9 H2; PT-BR ≈1,425 substantive words / 9 H2.

factual_methodological.summary: Central current statistics checked against BEA, BLS, Federal Reserve and Census primary releases are consistent with the staged claims.

taxonomy.summary: Controlled classification is valid and consistent; phenomena is a valid array.

translation.summary: EN/PT-BR are materially equivalent in thesis, evidence and visuals.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Opening and headings are publication-grade and no template/meta-QA is exposed, but both locales fail the mandatory Country Context depth floor.

contextual_depth.summary: Correct transversal mechanisms are identified but remain too compressed; expansion must add distinct institutional, productive, demographic/social and external-transmission mechanisms.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: 2 Markdown tables + 2 charts + 2 causal flows in each locale
visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Exceeds the country-dossier visual floor; reviewed values and units are reproducible and locales are aligned.
visual_evidence_readiness.limitations: No map is currently blocking; reassess if spatial corridors become central in revision.

country_context_contract.summary: Country metadata and canonical related IDs pass, but §14 word-count and H2 floors fail in both locales.

contrary_evidence: Deep capital markets, energy production, research capacity and continental scale argue against a simple structural-decline thesis.
Below-average industrial utilization and uneven infrastructure/housing constraints argue against frictionless dominance.
limitations: Mechanical word counts exclude headings, visual/code blocks, table rows and raw URLs; both locales are sufficiently below 1,600 that parser-edge differences cannot cure the failure.
Broad regional-specialization claims would benefit from more direct primary evidence in the expanded revision.
notes: Rejected before materialization. No reports/, HTML, data/reports.json or global site surface was modified. Public-state recheck at reviewed HEAD found no canonical metadata for this ID.
